receipts.by: builder lane C (claude subagent), for Vandor's review
receipts.what: gains {0: 0, 1: -6} with track 2 muted on same-phase 997 Hz sines at -20/-26/-30 dBFS: predicted coherent sum -18.054 LUFS, measured -18.1 (WAV and AAC). Three spans from two tracks placed at 0, 2 and 3 s on a 4 s timeline: every sample within 1 LSB of the source (the float path), the gaps exactly silent, length exactly 192000 samples.

notes: arsenal/media/audio.py mix(): one stereo file from per-track dB gains and mutes, over one source or a list of spans {src, start, end, at, tracks, gains_db, mute, gain_db, fade_in_s, fade_out_s} (the editor's render audio). Each span is one input trimmed at the input (sample-exact on 1/sr timebases, 1 ms grid on MKV), resampled to stereo, gained, summed with amix normalize=0 (no hidden 1/N), delayed to its timeline sample. loudnorm= runs the measured two-pass loudnorm on the mix. The ffmpeg that arsenal.media.ff locates is a separate process whose licence depends on the build; the one saved on this machine is configured --enable-gpl --enable-version3, so it is not asserted here.
